embed.title: !broadcast (admin)
embed.description: Send a message from `config/broadcast.json` to registered users selected by location or area. Useful for maintenance notices, feature announcements, or event warnings.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}broadcast <filter> <message id>`

The message id is the `id` of an entry in `config/broadcast.json` (see `examples/broadcast.json`). Entries can set `"platform": "discord"` or `"telegram"`, or omit it to serve both. Only enabled user registrations receive it, never channels, groups or webhooks.

fields.name: Filter the audience
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}broadcast 51.5,-0.12 d5000 donate` — users whose location is within 5000 m
`{{prefix}}broadcast @london @paris donate` — users who have any of those areas selected

A location (with a `d` distance in metres) and areas can be combined; a user matching either receives the message. At least one filter is required.

fields.name: Test
fields.value: `{{prefix}}broadcast test donate` — send the message only to yourself.

fields.name: Care
fields.value: Broadcasts count against per-user rate limits. A large broadcast can take minutes to complete as the dispatcher paces it through platform API limits. You'll see delivery progress in logs.
